credit: NISAR L2 GCOV, NASA/JPL-Caltech and ISRO, via ASF DAAC (NASA Earthdata)
definition: R = HH, G = HV, B = HH minus HV (dB, the co/cross ratio); each channel stretched between fixed pooled 2 and 98 percent limits of all L-band coast dates, then gamma. Two polarisations only: NOT a Freeman-Durden or Yamaguchi decomposition.

B.channel: HH minus HV, i.e. the co/cross ratio (dB)

legend.label: Vegetation
legend.rule: HH -12 to -6 dB and HV -18 to -13 dB

legend.label: Very bright with weak cross-pol
legend.meaning: very bright with weak cross-pol, possible double bounce (flooded vegetation, buildings)
legend.rule: HH > -3 dB and HH minus HV > 11 dB

legend.label: Smooth bare or wet ground
legend.rule: HH -17 to -12 dB and HH minus HV > 9 dB

legend_note: swatch = median colour of the pixels that follow the dB rule (all dates of this group pooled); a hint about what a colour often means, not a class
stretch_scope: pooled valid pixels of all 4 L-band coast dates (2026-10-04, 2026-10-16, 2026-10-28, 2026-11-09), 84473364 pixels; a new date moves the limits on the next build
